messages:
Emily: CI image push failed on main after the Dockerfile tweak — registry returns 401 for a couple blobs then a 422 for finalize. I rolled one commit back locally and it pushed fine. anyone else seeing this?

Ryan: saw a flurry of 401s earlier, looked like token refresh hiccup from our registry side. but 422 finalize is odd — can you paste the build logs?

Emily: paste: ```
# build log snippet
STEP 10/12 : COPY --chown=app:app build/ /srv/app/
 ---> Using cache
 ---> 3e5f7a1d4c2b
Step 11/12 : RUN /usr/local/bin/optimize-assets
 ---> Running in 9d2f4a
Uploading layer 3e5f7a1d4c2b
failed to upload blob: unexpected status: 401 Unauthorized
retrying...
failed to finalize upload: 422 Invalid manifest
```

ci-bot: Build #4823 (main) marked red. Rerun job: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/4823/retry

Maya: that COPY --chown shouldn't change layer digest if content identical, but using chown can make buildx create different tar metadata sometimes — seen this with buildkit+rootless. could be cache/sharing mismatch across runners.

Sasha: ops, any token rotations today? ops-bot: We did a KMS key rollover at 03:04 UTC but no auth service restarts. Token issuer reported a transient error for 90s, could explain the 401s.

Ryan: my hunch: two problems colliding — transient token errors caused aborted uploads, then when runner retried a slightly different layer tar (due to chown or mtimes) registry complained on manifest finalize (digest mismatch -> 422).

Emily: quick triage plan: 1) re-run CI (no change) to see if transient resolved 2) force no-cache build to reproduce chown effect 3) bisect to the Dockerfile commit if it reproduces. ok to proceed?

Maya: +1. For reproducer, run locally with buildx and rootless: `DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker buildx build --load --no-cache .` and watch layer tar ids `docker buildx du` to compare.

Sasha: I'll tail registry logs and correlate timestamps from CI run 4823. If we see 401 spikes matching the failed uploads, we'll mark the KMS rollout as associated and schedule a short mitigation (retry/backoff tuning).

Emily: started rerun, pinged with `@ci-bot rerun` — will post the new logs. If rerun is green, we'll probably just call it transient. If it repros with --no-cache, I'll open a small PR to change COPY ordering to avoid chown or add explicit chown + touch to normalize mtimes.

Ryan: if you hit it locally, try `tar --mtime='1970-01-01' -c` style step to normalize timestamps in the layer as a test. also check buildkit versions on runners; mismatched buildkit can change artifact layout.

ci-bot: Rerun started: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/4823/4830

Emily: thanks — results incoming. will follow up with the bisect link if needed. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
